description: scriptconv's grapheme-level passthrough backend (Phonemizer.GRAPHEMES): returns the input characters unchanged, no phonemization occurs. Registered as a second identity baseline distinct from Phonemizer.UNICODE (different registry entry, same observed behaviour on ASCII input) so the arena's identity-baseline row is not silently deduplicated.
notes: Verified working (trivially) for en-US and pt-PT in the shared venv, no package extra required. Not eligible as a gold/reference source - performs no phonemization.
